## Summary
Extends the isolated visual-preview architecture to the Authentication Workspace, matching the approved Claude Design export (\mindmosaic-authentication.html\, artboards b0–b19).

### Implemented Screens & Artboards
- **Entry & Role Selection (b0–b2)**: Dual paths for parents and students with distinct cards, badges, and CTAs.
- **Parent Sign-in (b3, b4, b5)**: Email and password sign-in form with toggleable visibility, remember checkbox, and forgot password trigger.
- **Parent Sign-up (b6, b7)**: Account registration with full name, email, password strength indicator, and policy agreements.
- **Check Inbox (b8, b9)**: Email verification confirmation screen with resent state demonstration.
- **Password Reset (b10, b11)**: Password reset request flow and new password setup.
- **Student Sign-in (b12–b14)**: 8-character login code (\XXXX-XXXX\) and 6-digit secret PIN entry.
- **Student Error & Status States (b15–b17)**: Simulated wrong code, wrong PIN, and network retry states.
- **Session Expired (b18)**: Security timeout screen directing user back to sign-in.
- **Paused Profile (b19)**: Inactive student status explaining parental pause action.

### Preview Gate & Isolation
- **Gate**: \AUTH_PREVIEW=1\, loopback host only (\localhost\, \127.0.0.1\), \!isSupabaseConfigured\, not on Vercel.
- **Zero Real Writes**: Form submissions only update local React state. No credentials collected or transmitted.
- **Outside Preview**: Standard Supabase auth and forms execute completely untouched.

### Verification Passed
- \
pm run typecheck\: Passed (0 errors)
- Vitest \src/tests/pages/auth-preview-mode.test.tsx\: Passed (10 tests)
- \
px next build --webpack\: Passed cleanly (compiled all 69 static & dynamic routes)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
